summary_md: This looks high-impact (auth/payments/sends/migrations). The lane planned it but paused for your go before doing anything. Plan: ## Plan for ARCA-61 — Saved watchlists not persisting  ### What I found from a read-only audit (no changes made)  I traced the full path: `WatchlistPage.tsx` → `client/src/lib/api.ts` → `modules/watchlist/handlers.ts` → `db/auth.ts` → SQLite.  - **Client** (`WatchlistPage.tsx`): no localStorage/sessionStorage, no anonymous fallback. It only calls `api.get("/watchlist")` on mount and `api.get("/watchlist/:id")` when a list is selected. `api.ts` sets `credentials: "include"` so cookies are sent on every request. - **Server auth**: `watchlistRouter.use("*", ...)` (modules/watchlist/hand
